prompt: Which U.S. airline had the highest percentage of delayed flights over the full calendar year of 2024, according to the U.S. Department of Transportation's Air Travel Consumer Report?
answer: **Frontier Airlines** had the highest percentage of delayed flights over the full calendar year 2024, according to the DOT’s Air Travel Consumer Report. It had the lowest full-year on-time arrival rate among the reporting U.S. carriers.
